item.title: Flomaton Council Reappoints Key Staff, Holds Off On New Police Chief After Derek Lowry Resignation
item.description: Flomaton’s police chief has resigned, and the appointment of a replacement has been delayed for at least a week. Dereck Lowry resigned as police chief last Friday, Mayor Arthur Odom announced to the town council Monday night. He had served as chief since May 2024. item.title: International Paper Awards $65,000 In Community Grants
